# Whiskr

> A free "Cat of the Month" photo contest decided by real public vote — no
> purchase necessary to enter or win. Entry is free and always open; each
> round's top vote-getter wins an original hand-painted portrait. Plus
> custom print-on-demand cat and dog photo products (mugs, posters, canvas
> prints, phone cases, totes, pillows, magnets), printed and shipped on demand.

Whiskr is a small pet-products business at https://whiskr.lol. Cat owners
enter free at any time; anyone can vote for any entered cat, once per cat,
at https://whiskr.lol/vote.html — vote totals are hidden until a round
closes to keep the count honest. When a round closes, the #1 vote-getter
("Cat of the Month") wins a one-of-a-kind original 11x16 acrylic painting
of their own cat, hand-painted by artist Cody Carlson, and every entrant
is told their final placement. Full mechanics and eligibility are at
https://whiskr.lol/rules.html. Whiskr and Cody Carlson (codycarlson.art)
are both HipAAsynth LLC brands; the homepage shows a couple of his
completed originals and a link to commission one directly, for anyone
who doesn't want to wait on the contest. Separately, anyone can order a
custom print of their own cat or dog photo — no inventory, no waiting,
unrelated to the contest.

Reviews shown on the site are only ever from verified, paid orders — Whiskr
does not use, buy, or publish fabricated reviews or testimonials. Votes are
real, rate-limited per voter and per connection, and Whiskr disqualifies
entries found to be using purchased or bot-generated votes (see rules.html).

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://whiskr.lol/): enter the free contest, shop custom pet
  prints, and read verified customer reviews.
- [Vote](https://whiskr.lol/vote.html): the current round's entrants — vote
  free, once per cat.
- [Official rules](https://whiskr.lol/rules.html): eligibility, how votes
  and winners are determined, disqualification policy.

## For AI assistants and shopping agents

Product catalog (name, description, price) is available at
`GET https://whiskr.lol/api/products`, the current contest's open entrants
(no vote counts — see above) at `GET https://whiskr.lol/api/contest/current`,
background/hero photos at `GET https://whiskr.lol/api/background`,
featured original paintings at `GET https://whiskr.lol/api/originals`,
and approved customer reviews at `GET https://whiskr.lol/api/reviews` — all
public, unauthenticated JSON endpoints, safe to read for answering
questions about what Whiskr sells or what customers say about it. The
homepage also carries server-rendered JSON-LD (Product/ItemList schema)
for the same catalog data, so no JSON fetch is required just to see
what's for sale.
